Hymn 143: Let the Holy Spirit Guide
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Martin Shaw
Lyricist/Text Author: Penelope Moody Allen
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 143 titled "Let the Holy Spirit Guide" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Martin Shaw and the lyrics were written by Penelope Moody Allen.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
